title: canadian dollar adds weekly decline despite sharp gdp gain 2026 08 28
text:
TORONTO, Aug 28 (Reuters) - The Canadian dollar weakened to a nine-day low against its U.S. counterpart on Friday, as investors doubted that strong domestic GDP data would make a ​difference at an upcoming Bank of Canada policy decision and after hawkish ‌comments by Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh.
The loonie was trading 0.3% lower at 1.39 per U.S. dollar, or 71.94 U.S. cents, after touching its weakest intraday level since August 19 at 1.3908.
